text:
rachel: Security scan flagged a vendor-built image that contains what looks like a Vault token baked into /app/config.json. found in staging image tag.

registry-bot: Alert: image-scan rule 'vault-token' triggered for image=us.gcr.io/redwood-staging/vendor-app:2026-04-01.

priya: Immediate actions: revoke token, quarantine image tag, search for other images with matching pattern, and check whether the token had transit/unwrap permissions. I'll revoke.

rachel: Good. Also ask vendor to stop pulling that tag and pause builds. We'll provide a manifest after we rewrap anything that used that token.

tom: Commands to run:
```
vault token revoke <token>
gcloud container images add-tag us.gcr.io/redwood-staging/vendor-app:2026-04-01 us.gcr.io/redwood-staging/quarantine:vendor-2026 || true
```

priya: Revoke done at 5067900020. Token had policies [kv:read, build:encrypt], no unwrap. Still treat as credentials leak.

infra: I'll schedule a KMS rewrap if build used a wrapping key. also blocking the tag in registry and notifying registry-ops.

rachel: Assigning postmortem owners: priya + tom. Follow-ups: enforce TTL on build-role tokens, add image-scan pre-publish hook for vendor artifacts, and update vendor onboarding docs.

registry-bot: Incident created REG-9001 "vendor image token embedded".

priya: I'll run a quick grep across images and registry GC will be requested after vendor confirms rebuild.

tom: For RBAC temporary stopgap: remove build-runner SA ability to create long-lived tokens and set max-ttl. PR queued.

rachel: Thanks all. Closing containment once vendor confirms rebuild and manifests are verified. :white_check_mark:
